reason: Round 4 (bundles on c95f603 refused R05-R08 at T54.1: 'release tasks without a behaviour scenario'): the R05-RX2 scenario files wrote requirements as 'W17: text' / 'W36/W18: text' while release_check.installed reads the task as the first whitespace token, so the gate test passed where the validator refused. No assertion removed; the validator is unchanged.
